summary: Remove whitespace around a value without changing its interior.
documentation: trim returns a new string after removing whitespace and line terminators from both ends. Text between those ends is preserved.
inputs: The string on which the method is called; no arguments.
returns: A new string with its edge whitespace removed.
caution: trim is not HTML sanitization or validation. It does not collapse spaces between words.
scenarios: Clean a customer name pasted into a contact form.
Remove padding from a product code read from a file.
Normalize a search term before comparing it with stored values.
title: Clean a pasted business name
problem: Return the input string with leading and trailing whitespace removed. Preserve case, punctuation and all internal spaces.
goal: Use String.trim() or an equivalent approach that demonstrates the same concept.
hint: Call trim on the input string.
